product_metadata.title: Reynolds Kitchens Cookie Baking Sheets, Pre-Cut Parchment Paper,25 Count (Pack of 4), 100 Total Sheets
features: PRE-CUT REYNOLDS PARCHMENT PAPER—Contains four boxes of 25 Reynolds Kitchens Cookie Baking Sheets, each measuring 12 x 16 inches (100 sheets in total)
NO CUTTING REQUIRED—These double-folded cooking paper sheets are perfectly sized for standard cookie sheets & lay flat without curling
SMARTGRID LINES FOR EVEN SPACING—1 and 2 inch guidelines on these baking parchment sheets take the guesswork out of spacing your dough
OVEN-SAFE TO 425 F & NONSTICK—Reuse these oven paper sheets up to three times & save your cookie sheets from stuck-on food again & again
BAKE WITH CONFIDENCE—These parchment sheets can be used all throughout the cooking process, from rolling to measuring to baking, & are compostable for easy clean-up
description: Whether you're baking cookies or preparing everyday meals in the oven, Reynolds Kitchens Cookie Baking Sheets let you focus on the joy of cooking. These pre-cut 12 x 16 inch pieces of Reynolds parchment paper are non-stick, so your food slides right off the baking sheet without breaking or crumbling—without the need for cooking spray or grease. These baking parchment sheets come pre-cut to the size of a standard cookie sheet, and lay flat without curling or rolling, so you don't waste parchment or time cutting it to size. Save even more time with the SmartGrid lines, which measure 1 inch and 2 inch squares to help space out your dough. Each sheet of oven paper is oven safe up to 425 degrees Fahrenheit, and can be used up to three times per cookie baking session. Have fun baking and get better results, time after time, with these pre-cut parchment sheets.
